evidence.quote: This study investigates whether simple execution-history features can identify flaky tests before they are re-run.
We address two research questions.
RQ1: How accurately can a gradient-boosted classifier identify flaky tests from execution-history features?
The dataset was collected from the public CI logs of 24 open-source Java projects hosted on GitHub between January 2023 and June 2024.

All projects use OSI-approved licenses that permit research use.
